title: Ericsson selected for 5G RAN modernization and expansion by Cellnex Poland
summary: Cellnex Poland, a leading operator of telecommunications infrastructure, selects Ericsson as one of the suppliers for network modernization and expansion of its Radio Access Network (RAN).
